description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-E performance (in percent) for two model categories under four SFT (supervised fine-tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “LLaMA-2-13B” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” each shown as a grouped set of four bars, while the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-E (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 50 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. For LLaMA-2-13B, the four bars are: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) at approximately 4%, “+ SFT on D0” (light orange with horizontal hatch) at about 20%, “+ SFT on D0, D1” (light purple with diagonal hatch) at about 28%, and “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” (salmon/pink solid) at about 30%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the corresponding bars are: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) at about 26%, “+ SFT on D0” (light orange with horizontal hatch) at about 45%, “+ SFT on D0, D1” (light purple with diagonal hatch) at about 50%, and “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” (salmon/pink solid) at about 51%. The bars are grouped by model rather than sorted by height, and the legend in the upper-left maps each color/hatch style to its SFT condition; no individual bars appear additionally annotated or specially emphasized beyond the consistent styling.
